assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to the patient's symptoms.
The service addresses the clinical indication for diagnosing an arrhythmia that could explain the patient's palpitations and exertional dyspnea.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The patient has a diagnosis of atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (Z86.73).
The patient has a diagnosis of atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10).
